title: Twice the covering number is at most one more than the edge count
statement: Let $G$ be a connected finite simple graph with $\varepsilon$ edges, and let $\beta(G)$ denote its covering number, the least number of vertices in a covering of $G$. Then \[ 2\,\beta(G) \le \varepsilon + 1. \]
hypotheses_covered: G is a finite simple graph
beta(G) is the covering number (minimum size of a vertex cover)
epsilon is the number of edges of G
